svg.title: BCM70015 pre-boot MFD latch observations
svg.desc: Two fresh exclusive stock-loader sessions observed chroma sampling control values zero, one, zero. Each session attempted two literal writes. Revision remained 0x50, GISB error status zero, and ARM bridge control 0x400f0. Ordered readbacks are not elapsed-time measurements or a rendered picture.

g.text: MFD chroma sampling: write, observe, restore
BCM70015 · 0x00540024 bit 0 · fresh stock-loader sessions, before ARM run
Both sessions: 2 target write attempts; revision 0x50; GISB error status 0; ARM bridge 0x400f0.
Four native H.264 controls: 180/180 frames each, EOS/cleanup PASS, identical frozen pixels.
Empirical latch/readback only. Shared transport, ordered samples, not engine execution, global idle or a source lease.
